general_information.name: MY NAME… I MEAN, ON PAPERS IT’S ROBERT, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE FULL THING EXACTLY AS IT’S WRITTEN. SORRY, MY HEAD’S A BIT ALL OVER THE PLACE TODAY. COULD YOU SAY THAT AGAIN?
general_information.address: Oh, the address… I can’t quite sort it out in my head right this second. I think the street is Millwood Road, but the rest of it’s slipping away on me. Could you ask it in smaller bits?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been mostly my mood… and appetite too, I’m hardly eating some days. Since the cancer diagnosis I’ve just withdrawn from things, not myself exactly, but I don’t feel like doing much. I’m between chemo cycles right now and it all feels… heavy. And, well, I’d rather it took me quickly.
current_concerns.goals: Just to get through the treatment, I suppose. And to be some use to my wife again. Maybe get back to the workshop if I can.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Well, there was some counselling at the cancer centre… oncology counselling, that was in 2026, I think about three sessions. That’s the only one I can remember.; In 2026.; About 3 sessions.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Ondansetron.; Dose: It’s 8 mg, and I take it twice a day as needed.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2026.; Side Effects: Constipation, from that one.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes, there’s another one… ramipril.; Dose: 10 mg each morning.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2014.; Side Effects: No known side effects.

medical_history.medical_conditions: There’s also hypertension. That was diagnosed back in 2014.
medical_history.surgical_history: Surgery: A hemicolectomy.; Date: In 2026.; Details: No, nothing else really.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two or three at weekends.; Duration: I don’t know exactly. It was before I stopped after the diagnosis.
substance_use.nonmedical_nicotine_use: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Cigarettes.; Quantity or frequency: About 20 per day.; Duration: 30 years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: I was self-employed.; Job Title: Plumber.; Dates: 1985 to 2025.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and raised in Toronto, from a practical working family. Not much else I can think of there.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I left school at 18 to start a plumbing apprenticeship. That’s mostly how I got going.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married for 36 years, and it’s current. We’re close. I’ve got three adult children too.
personal_history.future_goals: See my treatment through and get back to the workshop.
